HomeHero.welcomeDescription: Amavidiyo agxile okholweni avela emtapweni wethu ukuze akugqugquzele, akuphonsele inselelo, futhi akwenze uzindle.
HomeHero.morningTitle: Sawubona Ekuseni! Izikhathi ZeBhayibheli Zanamuhla Ziyakulinda.
HomeHero.morningDescription: Qala usuku lwakho ngezikhathi zeBhayibheli ezikhuthazayo ezenzelwe ukukugqugquzela nokuphakamisa umoya wakho.
HomeHero.afternoonTitle: Sawubona Ntambama! Izikhathi ZeBhayibheli Zosuku Lwakho.
HomeHero.afternoonDescription: Okuqukethwe kweBhayibheli okukhuthazayo, okufanele ikhefu lakho lasemini noma ukuqhubeka ukhuthazeka.
HomeHero.eveningDescription: Izikhathi zeBhayibheli ezinokuthula zokukusiza uzindle futhi uthole induduzo njengoba usuku lwakho luphela.
HomeHero.joinUsDescription: Isivuno silapha. Joyina thina njengoba sabelana ngevangeli nomhlaba wonke sisebenzisa imidiya yedijithali.
HomeHero.togetherDescription: Ukuze bezwe futhi babone uthando lukaJesu ngolimi lwabo, khona lapho bekhona.

Mission.headline: Umlayezo awushintshi. Indlela abantu ababuka ngayo iyashintsha.
Mission.intro: Sakha kabusha umtapo wethu wamavidiyo namathuluzi kusukela phansi, siletha amashumi eminyaka omsebenzi wokuhumusha ezinkundleni lapho abantu sebevele bebuthana khona, bebuka, futhi babelane.
Mission.libraryPointDescription: Amashumi eminyaka omsebenzi wokuhumusha, owenziwe ngabalingani bezinkonzo abathembekile, akhe umtapo onezinkulungwane zezilimi zomsindo ukuze abantu bahlangabezane nendaba kaJesu ngolimi olufinyelela ekujuleni kwezinhliziyo zabo.
Mission.formatsPointTitle: Sithwala amazwi athembekile siwayise ezindleleni ezintsha
Mission.formatsPointDescription: Sakha kabusha indlela izindaba zevangeli ezixoxwa ngayo ngokubonakalayo, sihlanganisa ukuhumusha okuthembekile namafomethi esimanje ukuze umlayezo uhambe ngokukhululeka ezinkundleni, emasikweni, nasezikrinini.
Mission.teamPointTitle: Okungaphezu komtapo. Ithimba eliqhutshwa yinjongo yokushumayela.
Mission.teamPointDescription: I-Jesus Film Project iyithimba lomhlaba wonke labahumushi, ochwepheshe bemidiya, abahleli, nabadali abaguqula amashumi eminyaka okuhlangenwe nakho kwenkonzo kube amathuluzi abenzi babafundi yonke indawo.
Mission.nextStepsDescription: Ixhumanisa ababukeli namathuba aphathekayo ohambweni lwabo olungokomoya, ibasize bathathe isinyathelo esilandelayo bangene emphakathini, emiBhalweni, noma emsebenzini wokushumayela.
Mission.mediaLibraryDescription: Umtapo omkhulu wemidiya yobuKristu onezinkulungwane zamavidiyo, amafilimu, nezinsiza ezitholakala ngezilimi eziningi zenkonzo nokushumayela emhlabeni wonke.
Mission.ministryToolsDescription: Ukuphathwa kwamavidiyo, ukusatshalaliswa kokuqukethwe, ukuxhumana nezethameli, nokuhlaziywa kwedatha okwenzelwe ukusiza izinkonzo zifinyelele abantu abaningi ngempumelelo.
Mission.inviteBody: Simema abasebenzi bensimu, abadali, nabalingani ukuthi baqale ukusebenzisa amathuluzi kusenesikhathi. Hlola amathuluzi amasha kuqala, nikeza impendulo, futhi usize ukwakha imikhiqizo eyenzelwe umsebenzi wangempela wokushumayela.
Mission.roadmapCardAriaHint: Ivula ikhasi lomsebenzi we-Jesus Film esigabeni sohlelo oluzayo
